title: DockCert: An Open-Source Toolkit for Statistical Validation, Enrichment Metrics, and Reproducibility Assessment of Molecular Docking Studies
description: An open-source scientific toolkit for rigorous quality assurance, redocking RMSD calculation, virtual screening early enrichment metrics (BEDROC, RIE, EF1%, EF5%, EF10%, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC), decoy bias diagnostics, bootstrap confidence intervals, and manuscript-ready reporting.
